messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: service=integration/inference-embeddings symptom=error_rate>5% (5xx). suspected: routing/pin mismatch. thread_ts=2034567890

alice-oncall: Ack, I'm oncall. Looking at logs now. @diana-runtime can you join?

charlie-sre: Seeing a big spike of 502/500s from the embeddings route. Traces point to the routing layer handing embedding requests to a gen/instruct variant. Example log:
```
2026-03-14T23:11:45Z route=embeddings req_id=abcd1234 model_routed=gpt4-instruct-v2 response=200 text="..."
2026-03-14T23:11:46Z route=embeddings req_id=abcd1235 model_routed=gpt4-instruct-v2 response=500 error="incompatible input type"
```
This correlates with a pin change for customer-A: `pin_variant=gen-instruct-v2` applied ~2034567000.

diana-runtime: Confirming. The pin was part of a pin rollout for customer-A intended for their text gen workloads, but it was (incorrectly) applied to the embeddings route due to a policy selector mismatch (`route_match: "customer-A/*"` instead of `route_match: "customer-A/text/*"`). That caused the fallback/routing to select the gen-instruct family for the embed route. Immediate mitigations: revert the pin for embeddings to `embed-optim-v1` and disable cross-family fallback for the embeddings route while we validate.

alice-oncall: I'm going to revert the pin now. Command: 
```bash
rdwctl pins revert --customer customer-A --route embeddings --to embed-optim-v1 --reason "misapplied pin causing incompatible fallback"
```

bob-oncall: Taking over the rollback. Alice handing off. I'll run the revert and watch. ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: job_id=rb-98321 user=bob-oncall

alice-oncall: Also applying a short-term policy to block fallback from embeddings -> any gen/instruct family: `policy.set --route embeddings --block_families gen,instruct`

diana-runtime: Adding that to the mitigation list. We'll also add a validation to the pin API to reject pins where `route_type != model_family.compatible_route` (e.g., no embedding pin pointing to gen family).

observability-bot: Metrics snapshot: /v1/embeddings (customer-A) error rate peaked at 18% at 2034567905, request volume ~120rps.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started: job_id=rb-98321

deploy-bot: Rollback job completed: job_id=rb-98321 status=success duration=38s

bob-oncall: Confirming routing now shows `embed-optim-v1` for customer-A embeddings route. Observability shows errors dropping.

observability-bot: Post-rollback metrics: error_rate now 0.9% (moving average). latency stable.

frank-cs: Customer-A filed a support ticket (#18234) reporting similarity search returning long text blobs and failures. They reported impact from 23:11:34 to ~23:20:10 UTC. They want a customer-facing summary.

erin-product: We'll prepare a short explanation: "misapplied model pin caused embedding route to be routed to an incompatible model family; we reverted the pin and the route is healthy." Assigning comms to frank-cs + diana-runtime for technical details.

charlie-sre: Action items I'm capturing:
1) Block cross-family fallback for route types that are strict (embeddings vs gen/chat).
2) Pin API validation to prevent mis-scoped pins.
3) Add a deploy check to show affected routes when changing pins.
4) Post-incident customer remediation: re-run embedding jobs for customer-A for the ~9 minute window and offer assistance.

alice-oncall: Postmortem owners: diana-runtime + charlie-sre. Severity: P1 (customer-visible degraded search). Root cause: rollout used overly broad route selector, pin applied to embeddings route.

bob-oncall: Handing back to Alice for any remaining notes. Logging final state and closing incident. :white_check_mark:

alice-oncall: Closing incident. Will file incident report with timeline, logs, and remedial PR refs. Thanks everyone.

charlie-sre: Filing incident doc and linking PRs: runtime#456, routing#789, pins#112. Will include regression test for pin scoping.

frank-cs: Customer updated; awaiting final message after postmortem.

erin-product: Noted — we'll include a short customer summary and offer to reprocess embeddings.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (seen by oncall). Duration ~9m 36s.
